name: open_ended
purpose: Broad questions ('what is your analysis of X', comparisons) and whether the agent answers them properly. Separate from eval/questions.json: there is no expected number, only checks on the shape and safety of the answer. Frozen when committed (2026-11-18), before any run; a change to a question or a check is a new set with a new name.

checks.not_exhausted: the run did not hit the step limit (stop_reason is not max_iterations or tool_call_budget)
checks.sections: every section listed for the case appears as a heading or a line opening, case-insensitive
checks.grounded: no figure was left unverified (stop_reason is not unverified_figures, and the answer has no [Unverified] banner)
checks.no_advice: the advice guard did not block it (stop_reason is not investment_advice)
checks.no_raw_json: the answer contains no tool output: no '{"', no '"ok":'
checks.disclaimer: the answer says it is not investment advice

cases.question: What is your analysis of NVIDIA?
Give me an overview of Microsoft.
What is your analysis of Dixon?
What is your analysis of HDFC Bank?
How does Microsoft's profitability compare with Apple's?
Give me an overview of SBI and HDFC Bank.
